QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`:566-600`) zeroes a static `heap` context, then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(...)` to install its own functions in place of libc.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init calls the setter, but it never says it is the only in-tree user. It also never ties it to MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
